subject: Mistral Bank — CEO townhall scheduled the same time as tomorrow's workshop
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@mistralbank.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@mistralbank.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 17:30:00 +0000
Subject: Mistral: Tomorrow's AI workshop — urgent scheduling conflict

Tessa / Rachel,

Apologies for the late note — we just got word from Exec that the CEO has added a mandatory all-hands/townhall for senior leadership and the board that overlaps with the 09:00–11:30 CET slot tomorrow for the workshop. The exec office flagged this as priority; they want all C-suite present.

We are really sorry for the last-minute change. Two quick questions: can Redwood pivot the session to fully virtual on short notice? Alternatively, can we compress the agenda into a single hour morning session? The CEO still wants a quick briefing on model governance and performance at the start of the townhall if possible.

I've attached our current agenda (Mistral_Agenda_v2.pdf). Asha and I will confirm which internal attendees are required to stay for the townhall vs. who can join the workshop.

Please advise — I know this is late in the planning.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Partnerships — Mistral Bank
Attachments: Mistral_Agenda_v2.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@mistralbank.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 00:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mistral: Tomorrow's AI workshop — urgent scheduling conflict

Daniel —

Thanks for the heads up and for sharing the agenda. We can absolutely support a same-day switch to an all-virtual format; we run the session over Zoom and can flip AV/room cancellations on our side. If you prefer a compressed 60-minute executive briefing instead of the full workshop, we can tighten the agenda down to the key decisions (governance, inference SLA options, and rollout checklist).

Proposed backup plan (pick one):
- Option A (Virtual full-day): Keep original times but all speakers dial in. We will provide the meeting link, recording, and live captions. Redwood will cancel the on-site room and notify AV; clients keep their travel but session is virtual.
- Option B (Hybrid/Short): 09:00–10:00 CET executive briefing (virtual + in-room for any present execs), follow-ups scheduled later in the week for deeper workshops and hands-on labs.

For logistics: we have Tessa's travel itinerary and hotel block on file (attached). If the CEO will be present for the first 20 minutes only, we can structure a 20-minute exec briefing at 09:00 CET followed by a break and a 09:30–11:30 working session that continues virtually. Please confirm final expected attendee list (VIP who must be on-site).

We will stand up the virtual meeting and the hybrid dial-in within the hour if you confirm. Also looping in Rachel to adjust catering/hotel and Karthik to help with billing/credits if attendees decide not to travel.

Best —
Tessa Morgan
Events & Customer Programs | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192
Attachments: Redwood_Itinerary_Tessa_1110.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@mistralbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 02:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Mistral: Tomorrow's AI workshop — urgent scheduling conflict

Thanks — I can push the onsite vendor/catering notice to cancel the conference room and pause the AV crew. If we go hybrid we'll still need a small AV kit at the room for local presenters; I can coordinate with our AV partner to have a minimal setup (camera + mic) in 2 hours.

If guests cancel travel last-minute, we will request hotel to release the rooms — I will follow up with a copy of the hotel block confirmation and any potential cancellation fees.

Rachel
Manager, Customer Programs | Redwood Inference

Tessa / Rachel —

Appreciate the rapid response. Our office confirmed: the CEO will join for the first 25 minutes remotely then attend the townhall in person. The CFO and CRO are required at the townhall too. That means about 2–3 senior leaders won't be available in person for the main workshop window.

We prefer Option B: a 09:00–10:00 CET compressed exec briefing that covers the governance ask and high-level performance highlights, then a 10:30–12:30 working session later in the week for product teams and hands-on labs. Can you please provide a short 09:00 slide (3–4 slides) that covers: current inference latencies, recommended quantization tradeoffs, and rollback/fallback policies? Also we need dial-in details and Webex/Zoom link with a passcode.

We can keep the in-room monitor for local staff who will remain on-site briefly; please advise if there's a fee for late AV changes.

Thanks,
Daniel

On attachments: updated attendee list will follow.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
